note: root: a checkout other than this one to read the town's built page from (Mungo is not committed yet: its session's page in the main checkout). onWater: the town's local 0 is its water's surface (Mungo floats on its salt lake): it is set on the lake's level there, not on the land. anchor: a point of the town's frame (less its centre) whose ground is set on the land's (default its centre); band: the blend outside R (m). The settlements placed in the open world as baked tiles (bake.py towns): which build's page, which part of it, where it stands. centre: the town's middle in its build's own frame (m); R: the footprint (the tile is cut there and the land takes the town's ground inside it); ground: 'canvas' (the build's terrainH and its painted ground, streets and all) or 'flat' (an Ancients site: its landform is its meshes, the land is its plain); rot: the turn from the build's frame to the world's (degrees, about the vertical; both have x east, z south); at: the settlement record it stands on, or 'canyon' for its canyon candidate. site: an Ancients page holds two copies of a site, side by side: the x of the one to keep.

Verge.note: the twin cities on the escarpment: the upper on the plateau (west), the lower on the abyss floor (east), the trail between. Its own ground mesh is kept (vertex colours, the streets painted in). anchor: its plateau meets the land's; the band is wide because its drop (934 m) is less than the scale model's there

Veladiga.note: the breached dam (decay 2): the ruin. Its canyon runs along the page's z; the scale model's runs east-west, so it is turned 90 degrees

Arcbeam.note: the living bridge-city (decay 0). It brings its own gorge and plateau as meshes; the land under it is its plain
